hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Single-column hero with brand/logo area above a large bold headline, short supporting paragraph, and a compact benefit list; strong vertical stacking rather than split-screen; CTA placement is secondary to immediate value framing.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Long-form landing page with a top hero, followed by a lead-capture/form block, then feature/product sections; sections are separated by clear vertical spacing and visual breaks instead of dense grids.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Functional lead-form card and information blocks with simple rectangular containers; minimal decoration, no glass effects, no prominent shadow styling indicated; utility-first presentation over marketing polish.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary action is likely a high-emphasis hero CTA and a form-centric conversion path; CTA hierarchy appears simple, with one main action and supporting form submission behavior rather than multiple competing buttons.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing pattern visible in the provided reference.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not visible in the provided reference; likely a standard utility footer if present elsewhere.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Logo-led hero with text-first layout; media usage is minimal in the visible portion, suggesting restrained visual treatment rather than heavy imagery or media panels.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Sequential product feature sections with strong headline, concise explanatory paragraph, then feature list items; supports progressive disclosure by moving from overview to detailed capability bullets.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form block immediately after hero; stacked fields inside a card, with hidden tracking inputs and a conversion-first layout. Forms are treated as a primary component, not secondary.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, utility-driven presentation with no visible motion systems in the provided HTML; if any motion exists, it is not structurally implied.
componentPatterns: feature section with headline and description
designNotes: Content hierarchy is conversion-led and informational, optimized for B2B product discovery.
The layout favors vertical reading flow and predictable section ordering.
Use restrained styling, clear typographic hierarchy, and compact bullets for feature explanation.
Preserve a simple form card after the hero for immediate lead capture.
Avoid carousel/tabs/accordion dependency unless content volume requires compression.
Keep alternating section treatments subtle or absent; rely on whitespace and typographic contrast.

personality.buyer: Professionals, creative teams, designers, marketers, and video producers needing enterprise-grade visual content creation
personality.reasoning: This product is clearly in the AI category because it offers generative image and video models (Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro). The strongest fit is a cinematic AI visual language: deep near-black base, violet-cyan energy, glassmorphism surfaces, and futuristic motion cues. The page should feel like a high-end creative lab rather than a generic SaaS dashboard, while still keeping Techjockey’s B2B trust and conversion structure. The brand’s orange can be used sparingly as a secondary CTA or trust accent, but the overall identity must remain distinctly AI-native and premium.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and needs a compact but still bold presentation to preserve hierarchy without wrapping too aggressively.

colours.colourReason: The product is AI generative, so the palette uses a deep near-black foundation with violet-led cinematic energy. This preserves the required AI theme while staying visually distinct from generic SaaS purple by anchoring the layout in ByteDance-style premium darkness and luminous gradients. Techjockey orange is intentionally not the dominant palette; it can appear only as a restrained conversion accent where needed.

backgroundSystem.hero: radial gradient from #1a1033 to #0a0014 with subtle cyan-violet glow

layout.heroBackground: deep near-black with luminous violet-cyan gradient mesh and layered glass panels
layout.heroReason: The product has strong visual output potential, so the hero should immediately showcase an immersive AI creative environment with text on one side and a premium abstract model visual on the other.
layout.featureReason: Seedream and Seedance are two distinct products with different capabilities, so alternating sections create stronger contrast and help separate image generation from video generation while maintaining a cohesive premium feel.
layout.darkSectionFor: hero, product showcases, capability deep-dives, pricing highlight

personality.imageryDirection: Use premium abstract AI visuals rather than literal stock photography: layered interface shells, floating prompt cards, output preview frames, video timeline strips, waveform accents, and cinematic scene thumbnails. For Seedream, show multi-image composition, typographic render examples, and high-resolution output previews. For Seedance, show synchronized video/audio generation with timeline, lip-sync, and camera motion cues. Keep visuals glossy, dimensional, and highly polished.
personality.designPersonality: A premium cinematic AI lab for serious creative professionals: dark, intelligent, high-contrast, and visually charged. The experience should feel like enterprise-grade generative infrastructure wrapped in a polished creative studio interface, with layered glass cards, subtle glow, and bold product storytelling.

designIntent.audience: Professionals, creative teams, designers, marketers, and video producers seeking high-quality AI visual content creation
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate ByteDance's generative AI capabilities for professional image and video creation, then request a quote or demo

brandDirection.tone: Expert, capable, and commercially useful with a strong product-led focus; confident but not overly promotional
brandDirection.visualStyle: Tech-forward editorial landing page with a strong text-first hero, clear vertical rhythm, restrained imagery, and utility-led cards

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish the value proposition immediately: professional AI image and video generation powered by ByteDance models, with a single dominant action to generate with AI
Explain Seedream 4.5 as the core image-generation product, emphasizing high-resolution output, text alignment, editing, and composition benefits
Position Seedance 1.5 Pro as the complementary video-generation capability, highlighting synchronized audio-video creation and cinematic control
Support commercial evaluation with quote-oriented plan cards and a starting price anchor for video generation
Add credibility through role-specific practitioner quotes showing creative and production value

componentNeeds.notes: Use large bold headline, short supporting paragraph, one primary CTA, and a compact benefit summary. Keep visual treatment restrained and authoritative.
One dominant conversion action. Keep secondary actions minimal since no explicit secondary CTA is provided.
Present 5-6 feature points in structured cards or list items, with strong headline and concise supporting copy.
Differentiate video capabilities from image generation with a separate section and clear section label.
No full e-commerce purchase flow; keep pricing as evaluation support with clear includes lists and quote CTA.
Use the strongest three testimonials only; exclude incomplete or low-quality entries.

layoutStrategy.hero: Single-column hero with strong vertical stacking, brand/logo area above the headline, large bold title, short supporting paragraph, compact benefit line, and one high-emphasis CTA. Avoid split-screen treatment unless product media becomes available.
layoutStrategy.features: Use clear sequential product sections rather than mixed grids. Seedream should lead with 2-column feature cards or structured bullets for dense capability coverage; Seedance follows with similar structure but visually differentiated through section labeling and copy hierarchy.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use testimonials after pricing to support decision confidence, with role-based quotes and restrained card styling. If additional proof is unavailable, rely on product clarity and pricing anchors rather than forcing trust badges.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Treat pricing as an evaluation section, not a checkout section. Use simple cards with includes lists, quote CTA, and a clear starting price only where provided. Avoid adding missing discount or EMI elements.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be designed because includeForm is false. Conversion should route through CTA buttons and quote/demo intent.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Default Techjockey B2B visual language with a professional, modern SaaS feel; use the default font pairing (Plus Jakarta Sans for headings, Inter for body) and a trust-led color treatment with disciplined spacing and white-card sectioning
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a long-form single-product landing page with a highly focused hero, followed by two sequential product explanation sections for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro, then pricing and testimonials. Prioritize conversion through clear hierarchy, compact benefit framing, quote-oriented pricing cards, and credibility from practitioner testimonials. Keep the layout text-first, structured, and utility-driven with subtle motion, strong spacing, and no form block.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: Use default Techjockey B2B tokens with marketing-friendly accent treatment: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings, Inter for body, white feature cards, light grey separators, primary hero background in deep blue/indigo family, and orange-accent CTAs for conversion emphasis.

sections.variantHint: centered text-first hero with brand/logo area above headline; no split media panel
sections.notes: Use strong vertical stacking with brand area, large headline, supporting paragraph, short supporting line, and CTA row. Since no hero media is provided, keep the layout text-led and conversion-focused. Primary CTA should be the only prominent action; secondary CTA remains empty and should not be rendered as a button if no label exists.

sections.variantHint: light grey strip with badge placeholders only if content exists
sections.notes: No badges, social proof, or customer count are provided in the input. Do not fabricate trust metrics or logos. If a trust container is needed for layout continuity, keep it minimal and empty or omit entirely in the Figma build. Since the input has no trust content, this section should be treated as not rendered in the final page composition.

sections.variantHint: centered form card, stacked fields, high-contrast conversion block
sections.notes: The input does not provide form copy or fields, but the reference pattern expects a dedicated lead block immediately after the hero. Because form fields are missing, build a placeholder conversion card only if the project owner confirms lead capture requirements; otherwise omit in production composition. If kept for wireframe, use stacked input slots and a primary submission CTA placeholder without invented labels.

Present as the first detailed product section with a strong section headline, concise description, then a 3-column grid of feature cards on desktop. Use white cards with 1px borders and 12px radius. The first card should summarize Seedream's advanced capabilities; the remaining capability bullets should be rendered as individual cards or compact feature items depending on available space, preserving the progressive disclosure pattern.

Render as the second detailed product section. Because there is no media asset, keep it text-first and use the same card language as Seedream for consistency. Use a 3-column grid on desktop and preserve the feature list as structured cards or list tiles. Do not introduce an image or video preview panel.

sections.variantHint: 2-up pricing cards; quote-style pricing without fabricated discounts
sections.notes: Build two pricing cards in a side-by-side grid. Because the first plan has no price, render it as a quote-card with includes list and CTA. The second plan has explicit starting price, so include the price hierarchy exactly as provided. Do not invent original price, discount, EMI, or trust line values that are absent from the input.

sections.variantHint: 3-column testimonial cards with star row, quote, author metadata
sections.notes: Use the provided headline prompt from extras: 'What Professionals Say About Seedream and Seedance?' Maintain the standard testimonial card treatment with left accent border and gold stars. The fourth testimonial entry is incomplete ('T') and should be excluded from the build to avoid broken content. On desktop, use a 3-column layout with 3 valid testimonials.

frame.name: Mobile / Seedream 4.5 + Seedance 1.5 Pro Landing Page

sections.variantHint: single-column stacked hero, text-only, full-width CTA
sections.notes: Stack all hero content vertically with full-width CTA. Since there is no image, use a text-only hero and keep line lengths controlled. Reduce headline scale appropriately for the long headline and preserve readable hierarchy. CTA buttons should stack with primary first if a secondary ever appears.

sections.variantHint: full-width form card with stacked inputs
sections.notes: If retained, the form should be a full-width card with vertically stacked inputs and a full-width primary CTA. Since no fields are supplied, this should remain a structural placeholder only until lead form content is confirmed.

Convert the 3-column desktop feature grid into a single-column vertical stack of cards. Preserve the section headline and description, then render each feature item as an individual card or list item. Keep spacing generous to support long-form reading on mobile.

Render the Seedance section as a single-column sequence with cards and bullet-like feature rows. Avoid side-by-side layouts. Keep all copy intact and maintain visual separation between feature items using borders and vertical spacing only.

On mobile, stack both pricing cards vertically and keep each card full-width. The first plan remains a quote-style card; the second uses its starting price. Do not add hidden pricing metadata that is not in the source content.

Use a single-column testimonial stack for mobile. Include only the three complete testimonials. Exclude the malformed fourth entry. Preserve star rating, italic quote, author name, designation, and company metadata style.

figmaExecutionNotes: Keep the page strictly text-first and conversion-led; no fabricated imagery, logos, trust badges, or form fields.

Exclude the malformed testimonial entry and do not invent missing trust or pricing details.
Use 8/16/24/32/48/64/96 spacing increments consistently across all frames and auto-layout stacks.
Feature sections should use white cards with subtle borders; no heavy shadows or decorative effects beyond the system card treatment.
Mobile should be a true stack of the same content order with full-width CTAs and single-column cards.
